description: This file defines a budgetsService module for managing budget data via a Supabase backend. It includes functions to list, create, update, delete budgets, and compute utilization. The module handles different database schemas where the budget limit column may be named 'limit' or 'budget_limit'.

methods.name: budgetsUsesBudgetLimit()
methods.description: Performs a lightweight schema check to determine if the 'budgets' table uses 'budget_limit' column or 'limit' column by attempting a select query and analyzing errors.

methods.name: normalizeBudgetRow(row)
methods.description: Normalizes a database row for a budget, ensuring the 'limit' property is correctly set from either 'budget_limit' or 'limit' fields.

methods.name: listBudgets(userId, month)
methods.description: Fetches a list of budgets for a user, optionally filtered by month, handling schema differences.

methods.name: mapLimitForWrite(payload)
methods.description: Prepares the payload for insert or update operations, mapping the 'limit' property to the correct database schema field.

methods.name: createBudget(budget)
methods.description: Creates a new budget record in the database, considering schema variations.

methods.name: updateBudget(id, patch)
methods.description: Updates an existing budget record by id with provided patch data, handling schema differences.

methods.name: deleteBudget(id)
methods.description: Deletes a budget record by id.

methods.name: computeUtilization({ userId, month, budgets })
methods.description: Calculates total spent and budget utilization per budget for a user in a specific month.

ctags.name: computeUtilization
ctags.pattern: /^export async function computeUtilization({ userId, month, budgets }) {$/
